brand.tagline: Find care homes in England and see how the regulator rates them.

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.summary: Every care home the Care Quality Commission (CQC) regulates, on one map, with its latest inspection rating.

sections.heading: What this is for
sections.body: Choosing a care home is hard, and the facts are spread across spreadsheets and inspection reports. Carehome Intel puts CQC's public data in one place so anyone can see which homes are near them and how each was rated.

items.title: Open the map
items.body: Choose Map in the menu. Each marker is a care home, coloured and lettered by its latest overall CQC rating.

items.title: Search
items.body: Open the search menu and look for a home by name, by location (town, county, council area or region) or by the start of a postcode. You can also keep only the ratings you want.

items.title: Read the details
items.body: Hover over a marker for the home's name and rating; select it for the address, beds, type of care, who runs it and a link to its inspection reports on the CQC website.

items.title: From the regulator
items.body: Records come from CQC's monthly care directory or its API. Contains Care Quality Commission data, licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.

items.title: England only
items.body: CQC regulates care in England. Homes in Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland have their own regulators and are not shown as yet.

items.title: A starting point
items.body: A rating is a snapshot from the last published inspection. Read the full report and visit a home before deciding.

pages.title: Roadmap
pages.summary: Where the project is heading, milestone by milestone.

items.title: The map
items.body: Care homes on a map, coloured by rating, with search by name, location and postcode on web and mobile.

items.title: CQC data models
items.body: Model CQC's location and provider records in full, including the rating for each key question.

items.title: CQC API
items.body: Keep the records current from CQC's API as well as its monthly spreadsheet.

items.title: Reports and recommendations
items.body: Bring in what the inspection reports say, and help people compare homes.

items.title: Plain facts
